**Essential Job Functions:**

  

* This is a senior-level position reporting to a Risk Monitoring Director and supports both that direct manager in identifying existing and emerging risks, and interactions with internal and external parties.
* Conducts risk monitoring activities, that can include complex or elevated risk firms with guidance and minimal supervision of a Risk Monitoring Director or designee.

* Mentor and coach more junior level risk monitoring staff.
* Serve in leadership roles related to special projects and technology initiatives.
* Ability to perform as part of a team conducting monitoring (including coordination with specialists) to execute against risks of assigned firms.

* Demonstration of FINRA’s values.
* Collaboration, both in-person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA’s mission of investor protection and market integrity.

**Job Requirements**  

**Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology**

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

**1. Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

**2. Reach, Scale & Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

**3. Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Product & Technology Analytics is responsible for the data analysis, measurement, and insight generation that inform product strategy and decision-making across Disney Entertainment’s streaming and digital portfolio. This includes experimentation analysis, KPI development, BI development, and cross-functional partnership with product management, engineering, and programming teams to drive data-informed outcomes across Disney+ and Hulu.

**Job Summary:**

The Product & Technology Analytics team is seeking a Lead Data Analyst who will be a key player in driving personalization strategy on Disney+ and Hulu.

Our ideal candidate is an excellent coder and communicator who crafts high-impact, data-informed stories to decode challenging and unstructured problems, and can responsibly manage complex projects that cross several silos. If you go beyond gathering data and you consistently transform it into knowledge and meaningful business action, this is a great role for you.

You’ll contribute the following to this critical squad:

* **Deep-Dive Research:** Lead large-scale analyses of product performance and user behavior. Apply statistical modeling, experimentation, and causal inference to identify opportunities and influence product strategy.
* **A/B Testing & Experimentation:** Lead the design, analysis, and interpretation of personalization experiments, including power analysis, metric selection, SQL/Python analysis, and stakeholder recommendations.
* **Analytics Foundations:** Partner with product and data engineering teams to improve data quality, build scalable datasets, and instrument new product features for reliable analysis and reporting.
* **AI-Enabled Analytics:** Use and help advance AI-assisted tools and workflows to improve the speed, scale, and quality of analysis.
* **Ad Hoc Analysis:** Investigate product issues, analyze user behavior, and rapidly answer complex business and product questions using large datasets.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or another technical field
* 7+ years of data analytics experience, including 3+ years in a senior or lead-level capacity.
* Advanced SQL and Python skills, including complex analysis of large datasets, notebook-based workflows, and scheduled analytical jobs.
* Advanced knowledge of experimentation and statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing, power analysis, metric selection, regression, causal inference, test design, and interpretation.
* Product analytics experience, including user behavior, funnels, engagement, and feature performance.
* Experience building analyses, dashboards, and visualizations in Looker, Tableau, or a comparable BI platform.
* Proven ability to lead end-to-end analytical projects, define requirements, manage timelines, partner with data engineering, and deliver strategic outcomes.
* Strategic communication skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations for technical, business, and executive audiences.
* Experience building or applying AI-assisted analytics tools and workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in streaming media or subscription-based products
* Advanced knowledge of Looker
* Proven ability to manage projects that require new datasets, collaborating with data engineering teams to improve data quality and build foundational datasets for scalable analysis

We are seeking an Analyst to join the Global Corporate & Investment Banking (GCIB) Business Unit Risk & Control team. This role is responsible for supporting the RCSA program for assigned business areas. This includes the effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of operational and non-financial risks across a diverse portfolio of corporate and investment banking products and services.

  

The successful candidate will partner with team members and with business, product, operations, compliance, and risk management stakeholders to help strengthen the overall risk and control environment. This individual will support the execution of the business unit's risk management framework, ensuring risks are proactively identified, appropriately assessed, and effectively controlled in alignment with regulatory expectations and organizational risk appetite.

* Support the execution of the Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) program across Global Corporate & Investment Banking.

* RCSA activities include; Process and risk taxonomy alignment, Inherent-risk assessment, Control identification and mapping, Control design and operating-effectiveness evaluation, Residual-risk determination, Issue and action-plan linkage, Trigger-based and periodic reassessments, Documentation and evidence standards, System-of-record maintenance.

* Participate in RCSA meetings and working sessions and complete assigned deliverables throughout the RCSA execution lifecycle.

* Prepare process flows, risk and control assessment documentation, executive presentations, and other governance materials by using Microsoft Office and other tools.

* Identify opportunities to use approved automation, analytics, and artificial-intelligence tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of RCSA activities, in accordance with applicable information-security, data-privacy, records-management, and technology-risk requirements.

* Support the GCIB Risk and Control team by gathering information for requests, tracking deliverables, and preparing status reports.

* Proactively anticipate the needs of the team, offer recommendations and solutions, and prioritize efficiently to meet deliverable deadlines.

* Build subject matter expertise across covered banking products to better understand associated risk exposures and support informed decision-making.

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Compliance, Legal, Operational Risk, Audit, Technology, and Operations teams, to strengthen the overall control environment.

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Risk Management, Accounting, or a related discipline.
* 1-3 years experience in risk management, operational risk, controls, audit, corporate banking, investment banking, or a related financial services function.
* Basic understanding of banking products, operational risk frameworks, and control management principles and
* Willingness to learn banking products and risk-management concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Qualtrics Analytics and Insights Engineer III (CX / XM)
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.  
  
**Work You'll Do**  
  
As an Analytics and Insights Engineer III on the Customer Strategy & Design team, you will be responsible for:  

* Translating customer experience program objectives into Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) solution designs that define survey architecture, data models, workflows, and integration requirements.
* Configuring and optimizing Qualtrics surveys, embedded data, dashboards, automations, and logic for enterprise feedback programs.
* Building secure integrations between Qualtrics and customer relationship management, human resources information systems, and data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces, web services, or single sign-on.
* Deploying unmodified Qualtrics-provided Website/App Insights code in approved global headers or footers; avoiding multiple concurrent snippets; and testing data flow, intercepts, reporting, and workflow performance before production releases.
* Analyzing customer feedback data, building role-based dashboards, and training stakeholders on reporting and workflow use to support experience management adoption.

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
  
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  
  
Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required**:**  

* Bachelor's degree preferably in computer science, information systems, data analytics, software engineering, or business analytics.
* 2+ years of experience advising clients on best-practices of configuration for data collection.
* 1+ years of experience delivering platform demos and technical walkthroughs to business stakeholders, translating data-driven findings into clear action.
* 2+ years of experience analyzing customer feedback data and creating dashboard-based reporting.
* 1+ years of experience using JavaScript or Python to create survey logic, automate platform workflows, or deploy website feedback code.
* Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:
  

* Qualtrics certification.
* 2+ years of experience configuring Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) Platform surveys, workflows, embedded data, dashboards, and reporting.
* 2+ years of experience designing integrations between cloud platforms and customer relationship management (CRM), human resources information systems (HRIS), or data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), web services, or single sign-on (SSO).
* 1+ years of experience integrating Qualtrics with Salesforce, SAP, or Slack.
* 1+ years of experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies or public higher education institutions.
* 1+ years of experience configuring solutions in environments subject to Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) requirements.

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

The Associate Principal Analyst has demonstrated a proficient level of competence in identifying risks, developing regulatory strategies to address those risks and managing teams to achieve the goals of the strategies.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Lead or participate in, and provide guidance and advice with regard to files received by MAP, including complex/novel/unique or high risk applications. The Associate Principal Analyst possesses a proficient level of knowledge of relevant rules, regulations, guidelines and industry practices.
* Proactively identify notable trends in industry practices, products and procedures.
* Ensure regulatory programs serve departmental goals and FINRA’s mission in an efficient and effective manner.
* Demonstrate proficient issue spotting, strong critical thinking, interviewing, research and quantitative skills.
* Possess a proficient level of knowledge of securities products, activities of member firms and the industry.
* Assist other Analysts with the analysis of applications that may be complex/novel/unique/high risk.
* Ensures that applications and other matters are executed efficiently, with high quality, and in a timely manner.
* Actively lead and participate in meetings with member firms with minimal supervision.
* Proactively identify ideas for in-house training.
* Participate in developing course content and advising the Member Regulation Training unit on technical accuracy of classroom material.
* Serve as a mentor and coach to other staff.
* Moderate and/or present subject matter material at internal meeting and conferences including, new Analysts trainings or other FINRA training programs.
* Participate in Peer and/or Quality Reviews for the district, regional or national program.

* Demonstration of FINRA’s values.
* Collaboration, both in-person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA’s mission of investor protection and market integrity.

**Education/Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience required. Proficient level of knowledge of business conduct risk and industry practices, securities industry rules, regulations and best practices required.
* Demonstrate proficient knowledge of risk analysis and proactive risk identification. Possess strong analytical skills.
* Demonstrate a track record in developing appropriate regulatory responses and/or processes for managing risks.
* Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills.
* Possess excellent time management skills.
* Minimum of five years of securities, compliance or financial regulatory experience.
* Exemplify the FINRA Leadership Characteristics and serve as a role model for staff in the department.
* FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) certification or acceptable industry equivalent certification is required upon hire or within 16 months of the start date of the assigned SIE training cohort.

**Work Conditions**

* Hybrid work environment, with defined in-person presence requirements.
* Extended hours may be required.
* Work expectations include timely and high-quality productivity.
